Place OpenSSL Windows binaries here.

Expected layout:
  third_party/openssl/include/openssl/*.h
  third_party/openssl/lib/libssl.lib
  third_party/openssl/lib/libcrypto.lib
  third_party/openssl/bin/libssl-3-x64.dll      (copy next to TCGDrivePlugin.wfx)
  third_party/openssl/bin/libcrypto-3-x64.dll   (copy next to TCGDrivePlugin.wfx)

Recommended source:
  https://slproweb.com/products/Win32OpenSSL.html  (Win64 OpenSSL v3.x)
